project.name: VQSV-Web
project.description: A Laravel/Inertia foundation for a Vương Quốc Siêu Việt game wiki, accompanied by the extracted and decompiled Java ME RPG implementation that supplies evidence for pets, skills, items, combat, quests, and world systems.

nodes.name: Player Account & Security
nodes.summary: Handles the web player's identity lifecycle through registration, profile maintenance, password protection, and account closure. This is the implemented Laravel business surface for future personalized wiki capabilities.

businessRules: Email addresses must be unique and valid.
Passwords must satisfy the shared password policy.
Changing an email clears its verification timestamp.
Account deletion requires the current password and invalidates the session.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides authenticated identity for future wiki preferences and contributions.
Uses Laravel Fortify and session infrastructure.

nodes.name: Game Session & Persistence
nodes.summary: Controls Java ME startup, new/continued sessions, and durable player progress. It coordinates the MIDlet, menu, world runtime, and partitioned RecordStores.

businessRules: The Canvas owns the active scene loop.
Player, world, event, currency, pet, consumable, and ball state use separate PK6_RMS stores.
Loaded dependent state must be rebuilt before play resumes.
crossDomainInteractions: Restores pets, inventory, quests, and world position.
Starts exploration and transitions to combat.

nodes.name: World Exploration & Quests
nodes.summary: Runs map traversal, actors, scripted interactions, dialogue, tasks, and location transitions. The world controller and event engine combine map data with persistent quest state.

businessRules: World transitions update map, scene, and coordinates together.
Events are gated by stored state and contextual conditions.
Quest outcomes update persistent state, not UI state alone.
crossDomainInteractions: Encounters initiate battles and capture opportunities.
Quest outcomes grant items or pet progression.
Session persistence saves the current world and quests.

nodes.name: Pet Collection & Progression
nodes.summary: Manages pet definitions, the active team, reserve collection, capture, statistics, leveling, evolution-related actions, and learned skills. It is the central evidence domain for the planned Pet wiki.

businessRules: The active team is capped at six pets by the roster flow.
Stats derive from species, level, growth, and element data.
Capture requires battle-side success and available storage handling.
Level-up can require a learned-skill choice.
crossDomainInteractions: Combat uses pet stats and skills and produces experience.
Items heal, modify, capture, or evolve pets.
Persistence stores active and reserve pets.

nodes.name: Combat & Skills
nodes.summary: Implements turn-based battle, action ordering, skill selection, damage, buffs/debuffs, defeat, capture branches, and post-battle progression. It supplies behavioral evidence for the planned Skill wiki.

businessRules: Combat advances through an explicit state machine.
Skill availability comes from each pet's learned-skill data.
Damage and status resolution use stats, elements, and effect tables.
Completion resolves defeat, rewards, level-up, and scene return.
crossDomainInteractions: Returns progression results to the world.

nodes.name: Inventory, Items & Commerce
nodes.summary: Owns item categories, quantities, bag actions, shops, currency, and reward insertion. It is the main evidence domain for the planned Item wiki and links items to pets and skills.

businessRules: Items are separated into category-specific collections.
Use and purchase validate context, quantity, capacity, and currency.
Stacks decrement only after an accepted action.
Rewards mutate player holdings and persistent event state.
crossDomainInteractions: Items target pets, skills, battles, and quests.
Quest and battle rewards feed inventory.

nodes.name: Register Player Account
nodes.summary: Validates registration data and creates a durable web user through Fortify.

nodes.name: Receive Registration
nodes.summary: Fortify dispatches submitted identity fields to the user-creation action.

nodes.name: Validate Identity Fields
nodes.summary: Apply shared name and unique-email rules.

nodes.name: Validate Password
nodes.summary: Apply the shared password policy before creation.

nodes.name: Create User
nodes.summary: Create and return the accepted User record.

nodes.name: Update Player Profile
nodes.summary: Edits identity fields while preserving email-verification invariants.

nodes.name: Validate Profile
nodes.summary: The authenticated form request validates submitted profile values.

nodes.name: Fill User
nodes.summary: Copy validated fields onto the current user.

nodes.name: Reset Email Verification
nodes.summary: Clear verification when the email address changes.

nodes.name: Save Profile
nodes.summary: Persist, flash success, and return to profile settings.

nodes.name: Secure or Close Account
nodes.summary: Changes a password or closes an account only after credential validation.

nodes.name: Validate Credential
nodes.summary: Apply current/new password rules for the requested security action.

nodes.name: Update Password
nodes.summary: Replace the authenticated user's password and confirm success.

nodes.name: Delete User
nodes.summary: After current-password confirmation, log out and delete the user.

nodes.name: Invalidate Session
nodes.summary: Invalidate session data, rotate the token, and redirect home.

nodes.name: Start Game Session
nodes.summary: Boots the Java ME runtime, processes the menu choice, and initializes the playable world.

nodes.name: Boot MIDlet
nodes.summary: Create the Display and game Canvas and make it current.

nodes.name: Process Main Menu
nodes.summary: Handle new-game or continue selection in the menu state.

nodes.name: Initialize World
nodes.summary: Load event, pet-area, media, sprite, and world dependencies.

nodes.name: Enter World
nodes.summary: Reset coordinates and transfer control to the world scene.

nodes.name: Save and Restore Progress
nodes.summary: Serializes or rehydrates player and subsystem state through partitioned RecordStores.

nodes.name: Serialize Player
nodes.summary: Collect and encode player, party, position, and play-time values.

nodes.name: Persist Subsystems
nodes.summary: Write world, event, currency, pet, consumable, and ball partitions.

nodes.name: Decode Saved State
nodes.summary: Read player and dependent subsystem partitions back into runtime structures.

nodes.name: Resume Scene
nodes.summary: Validate rebuilt state and return to its saved world scene.

nodes.name: Traverse Game World
nodes.summary: Moves through loaded maps and applies coherent location transitions.

nodes.name: Load Map
nodes.summary: Load current map, scene, pet-area, and actor data.

nodes.name: Resolve Movement
nodes.summary: Update player interaction and movement against world objects.

nodes.name: Offer Transition
nodes.summary: Open the wharf/transport UI for an available destination.

nodes.name: Apply Transition
nodes.summary: Update map, scene, coordinates, and event context for the destination.

nodes.name: Execute Quest Event
nodes.summary: Evaluates an event branch, presents dialogue or choices, advances tasks, and commits rewards.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Player interacts with event or NPC

nodes.name: Load Event
nodes.summary: Decode the binary event record and indexed strings.

nodes.name: Evaluate Branch
nodes.summary: Check world, event, task, actor, pet, and inventory conditions.

nodes.name: Present Dialogue
nodes.summary: Render dialogue or task-choice UI for the selected branch.

nodes.name: Commit Outcome
nodes.summary: Advance task/event markers and grant the selected branch outcome.

nodes.name: Browse and Manage Pets
nodes.summary: Loads pet definitions, renders details, and manages active/reserve membership.

nodes.name: Load Pet Data
nodes.summary: Decode global pet-related database tables.

nodes.name: Construct Pet
nodes.summary: Initialize species, level, stat, element, and skill values.

nodes.name: Render Roster
nodes.summary: Populate pet-state UI with reserve entries and derived stats.

nodes.name: Apply Roster Action
nodes.summary: Validate capacity and transfer or release the selected pet.

nodes.name: Capture Wild Pet
nodes.summary: Consumes a capture item, calculates success, and transfers the target into ownership.

nodes.name: Choose Capture Item
nodes.summary: List available capture items and accept one.

nodes.name: Consume Capture Item
nodes.summary: Validate quantity, set ball type, and decrement inventory.

nodes.name: Calculate Capture
nodes.summary: Resolve capture probability from target and selected item.

nodes.name: Store Captured Pet
nodes.summary: Convert the successful target to owned data and add it to party/reserve handling.

nodes.name: Progress Pet
nodes.summary: Applies experience, derived level changes, evolution-related actions, and learned-skill choices.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Battle result or pet item action

nodes.name: Award Experience
nodes.summary: Apply battle experience to participating pets.

nodes.name: Calculate Growth
nodes.summary: Update level and derived pet statistics in the pet model.

nodes.name: Show Level Up
nodes.summary: Present stat changes and pending progression results.

nodes.name: Choose Learned Skill
nodes.summary: Prompt for a learned-skill choice and apply the selected slot.

nodes.name: Enter Pet Battle
nodes.summary: Transitions from world state, loads combat assets, and constructs combatants and turn order.

nodes.name: Trigger Battle
nodes.summary: Switch world orchestration into battle mode and load battle UI.

nodes.name: Load Combat Data
nodes.summary: Load positions, layers, effects, blood, and buff/debuff tables.

nodes.name: Construct Combatants
nodes.summary: Build player/opponent pet arrays and battle-specific state.

nodes.name: Order Turns
nodes.summary: Evaluate active combatants and prepare the initial action sequence.

nodes.name: Execute and Resolve Skill Turn
nodes.summary: Selects a learned skill, calculates targets/damage/status, and advances battle state.

nodes.name: Present Skills
nodes.summary: Open the chooser with the acting pet's learned skills.

nodes.name: Select Skill
nodes.summary: Pass the selected learned-skill identifier to battle state.

nodes.name: Resolve Effects
nodes.summary: Calculate hit/damage and apply elemental, special, buff, or debuff behavior.

nodes.name: Advance Battle
nodes.summary: Process remaining effects and move to the next actor or result phase.

nodes.name: Manage Item Inventory
nodes.summary: Displays category-specific bag contents and applies contextual item actions.

nodes.name: Open Bag
nodes.summary: Load the bag layout and current item category.

nodes.name: List Category
nodes.summary: Read item vectors and populate category-specific rows.

nodes.name: Show Item Details
nodes.summary: Resolve selected item data, quantity, description, and action.

nodes.name: Use Item
nodes.summary: Validate context/quantity, apply effect, decrement stack, and refresh.

nodes.name: Trade Items at Shop
nodes.summary: Browses stock and performs validated purchases or sales against currency and capacity.

nodes.name: Open Shop
nodes.summary: Load shop layout and browsing state.

nodes.name: Browse Stock
nodes.summary: Switch category and populate item data and prices.

nodes.name: Confirm Trade
nodes.summary: Present item, quantity, and price confirmation.

nodes.name: Apply Trade
nodes.summary: Validate funds/capacity and update currency and inventory.

nodes.name: Receive Gameplay Reward
nodes.summary: Turns an event or quest outcome into player currency/item ownership and visible feedback.

nodes.name: Resolve Reward
nodes.summary: Read reward type and payload from the event branch.

nodes.name: Validate Reward
nodes.summary: Check event state and inventory, pet, or world conditions.

nodes.name: Mutate Holdings
nodes.summary: Add item/currency or update the associated player collection.

nodes.name: Show Reward Feedback
nodes.summary: Present open-box/task-tip feedback and continue the event.

edges.description: Web identity is the ownership boundary for future personalized game and wiki state.
Save/load restores current world location and quest progression.
Persistence stores active and reserve pets.
Persistence stores currency and item quantities.
Encounters and scripted events initiate battles.
Quest outcomes grant or consume items and currency.
Areas and encounters determine available pets.
Pets supply combat stats, elements, health, and learned skills.
Healing, progression, evolution, and capture items act on pets.
Battle items and capture balls are consumed during combat.
